info.title: RSVP Guest and RSVP API
info.description: Additive lanes 17/18/19: guest management, opaque credentials and token-authenticated RSVP. Public APIs use Authorization Bearer, never a token in the URL. Lane 20 adds companion counts, scoped host decisions and public registration with safe approval defaults. Lane 21 adds host-only event-driven read models with freshness metadata and tenant-scoped replay operations documented in the service runbook. 1.9.0: optional email plus E.164 phone (at least one contact), explicit consent origin, respondedAt, group listing and reassignment, authoritative open companion-request total, paginated catering report, canonical invitation URL on token issue (see docs/ACCESS_TOKENS.md). Compatibility: Guest.email and GuestListItem.email may now be null (clients must tolerate null); every previously valid request remains valid. 1.10.0: POST /rsvp/resolve (credential -> celebrationId and slug, for legacy /rsvp/{token} links) and GET /rsvp/celebrations/{id}/public-settings (whether public registration of unregistered guests is enabled). Both public, additive, no-store.

post.description: Owner/co-host only. Issue or replace the only active token; a replacement atomically revokes its predecessor (reissue policy: every issuance invalidates the previous link at once, so a host resends by issuing again). Default TTL 7 days (604800 s), configurable from 60 s to 30 days. The raw token and the canonical url are returned once with no-store and are never persisted. resend=true requires the canonical url (503 if the web origin or slug is unknown).

resend.description: Re-issue to resend the invitation and require the canonical url in the response.

delete.description: Owner/co-host only. Revoke immediately, idempotently; no token required in URL/body.

get.description: No user account/JWT. Present the opaque magic-link credential in Authorization: Bearer. Missing, unknown, expired or revoked => identical 401; otherwise-valid foreign token => 404. No public guest list. Fixed UTC minute: Kong 30 requests/IP; service <=30/peer, shared persistently across instances. X-Forwarded-For is not trusted by the service.
Read only the RSVP belonging to the opaque guest token. A guest without a saved response receives PENDING. Deadline and its display use the celebration IANA time zone.

post.description: Create one RSVP per guest. A repeated request with the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the current state without a second outbox event. A second create with a new key returns 409.

patch.description: Change status or optional dietary/message fields before the deadline. Idempotent changes do not create duplicate outbox events.

get.description: Owner/co-host only. Paginated RSVP details for the host summary; dietary notes and messages are never returned to read-only actors.

200.description: Guest, or identical 404 for unknown/foreign guest

patch.description: MANAGE only. Moves a guest to another group of the same celebration (or out of any group with null). Atomically emits guest.guest.group-changed.v1 and updates the projected guest list. A no-op change emits nothing. A foreign or unknown group or guest is an identical 404.

get.description: MANAGE only. Groups of the celebration with member counts, ordered by name.

200.description: Service-owned companions default and authoritative celebration locale

post.description: Partial validation: invalid rows are reported and all accepted rows plus their outbox commit together in one transaction. A storage failure rolls back the accepted set and returns an error. Up to 1000 data rows and 1 MiB JSON body. Errors never echo personal input; empty CSV or invalid header returns a report without writes. CSV header: name, locale, allowedCompanions and at least one of email or phone (E.164); optional groupId. Imported guests record consent channel HOST_CSV and the importing host as the recorder.

200.description: Partial import report, including row errors

get.description: MANAGE-only pending inbox; never includes another celebration or erased guest.

post.description: MANAGE-only; APPROVED adopts the requested total, REJECTED keeps the permitted count. Same decision replays without events; opposite decision or stale/cancelled request returns 409. Deadline also applies.

Published celebrations with effective unregisteredRsvpMode=AUTO_ACCEPT only. Unknown, draft, archived, missing settings and RESTRICTED receive the same 403 before body validation. Creates Guest, CONFIRMED RSVP, hash-only token and outbox atomically. Required Idempotency-Key deduplicates concurrent submissions; replay returns only ACCEPTED and accessToken=null. Raw token is returned once: the client must save it for future edits; if its first response is lost, request a new magic link from the host. Does not identify/link an existing guest by email.

201.description: Accepted or replayed receipt; no-store/no-referrer; credential only on the first response

get.description: Owner/co-host (MANAGE) only. Reads persisted projections without querying write models. Freshness reports pending events and stale=true when oldest pending event exceeds the 5-second healthy-operation target; outages may exceed that target. updatedAt is the stored projection time, not request time. Never cached.

Owner/co-host (MANAGE) only. Reads persisted projections without querying write models. Freshness reports pending events and stale=true when oldest pending event exceeds the 5-second healthy-operation target; outages may exceed that target. updatedAt is the stored projection time, not request time. Never cached.

delete.description: MANAGE only. Irreversible local erasure, transactional outbox; 202 does not certify downstream completion. Repeating as host returns the same requestId.

202.description: Local identity erased, downstream erasure queued

delete.description: Erase only the guest authenticated by the opaque Bearer credential. The credential is invalidated immediately; another request with it returns 401.

202.description: Local identity erased, downstream erasure queued

get.description: MANAGE only. null means no approved retention schedule.

put.description: MANAGE only. null means no approved retention schedule.

get.description: MANAGE only. Keyset-paginated export of dietary needs (and optionally the free-text message) for the caterer, read from the authoritative RSVP rows. Contains no name, email or phone; erased guests are excluded. Never cached.

parameters.name: withNotesOnly
parameters.description: Only rows with non-empty dietary notes (or message when includeMessage=true).

post.description: Resolves an opaque credential to its celebration, without a slug in the URL. Returns nothing else (no guest id, name or contact). Missing, malformed, unknown, expired, revoked or erased-guest credential => the same 401. Failed attempts spend a per-origin budget; valid ones a per-credential budget (30/minute, shared with the other credential routes).

get.description: Lets the form know before submitting whether POST .../unregistered can succeed. Always 200 for any id (no existence oracle); per-origin budget.

token.description: Secret returned once; never persist or log in clear text

url.description: Canonical invitation URL ${PUBLIC_WEB_ORIGIN}/c/{slug}/rsvp/{token}. Present only in this issuing response (never stored or re-readable) when the web origin and the celebration slug are known; always present with resend=true.

IssuedGuestToken.description: The URL carries the secret in the path of a front-end route only; it must not be logged, indexed or sent to analytics.

preferredLocale.description: Explicit guest language, or null for current celebration default; exposed only to the valid guest credential.

respondedAt.description: Instant of the first response; null if still PENDING or for legacy rows whose first answer was not recorded.
Instant of the first response; null if still PENDING or for legacy rows whose first answer was not recorded.

locale.description: BCP 47; null/empty/omitted follows the celebration defaultLocale at read time

phone.description: E.164 (+ country code and number, 8 to 15 digits). Spaces, dots, dashes and parentheses are stripped on input.

RegisterGuest.description: At least one contact (email or phone) is required. The host attests the consent: the response records who and how.

preferredLocale.description: Explicit recipient locale; null uses current celebration defaultLocale.

phone.description: E.164 (+ country code and number, 8 to 15 digits). Spaces, dots, dashes and parentheses are stripped on input.

recordedBy.description: Who recorded it: the host user, or the guest itself for the public form. null for legacy data and after erasure.

openCompanionRequests.description: Authoritative total of open (PENDING_REVIEW) companion requests of the whole celebration; not the size of any page.

phone.description: E.164 (+ country code and number, 8 to 15 digits). Spaces, dots, dashes and parentheses are stripped on input.

groupId.description: Target group of the same celebration, or null to leave the current group.

guestId.description: Opaque key; the report never carries name, email or phone.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

slug.description: Public slug projected from Celebration events or a host call; null when not yet known (use celebrationId routes).

publicRegistrationEnabled.description: True only for a published celebration whose effective unregisteredRsvpMode is AUTO_ACCEPT. Unknown, draft, archived and RESTRICTED celebrations answer identically (RESTRICTED/false).

Unauthorized.description: Missing/invalid bearer or unknown/revoked guest token

Forbidden.description: Actor can read but cannot manage this celebration

NotFound.description: Resource missing or outside the actor/celebration scope

Dependency.description: Required upstream, versioned RSVP configuration or policy synchronization unavailable

Conflict.description: RsvpAlreadyExists, IdempotencyConflict or RsvpWindowClosed. A closed-window problem contains deadline (UTC), deadlineLocal, timeZone and locale; title is localized. CompanionRequestResolved for a completed or superseded request.

RsvpWindowClosed.description: RSVP deadline elapsed; title is localized and identifies the local deadline
